name: Amphiptere

facts.text: Level 71, 30,000 health. Every 5 s an ancient zombie (level 61-63) rises; 'A blow knocks one of Amphiptere's tooths to the ground'. Casts venom, Infection and Shield of Feathers.
An amphiptere is a winged serpent of heraldry.

story: An amphiptere is a winged serpent in the old heraldry, and the one on Caldey is the oldest thing on the isle: a great feathered snake with a mouth full of teeth as long as daggers. It sheds them when it is angry. A hard blow knocks a tooth to the ground, and where its teeth fall, the ancient dead of Caldey climb out of the soil, one after another, every few seconds, to fight beside it. It spits venom that clings like an acid cloud, spreads a sickness, and folds its feathers into a shield. The garrison on the Isle of Glass says Morgana did not have to raise the dead on Caldey. The serpent had been doing it for her for years.
legend: Ancient zombies keep rising around it every few seconds; off-tanks or area damage keep them down while the raid burns the serpent. Cure its disease, heal through its venom, and hit hard while its feather shield is down. Do not fight it near the barrows.

lairEntry: Teeth lie in the grass, long as daggers.
